title: feat(cli): Boot diagnostics noise budget, printer half: the line that needs the author first with its fix, stack traces only at debug
body:
Part of #22160 (the printer half; owners' levels routed)
Clause-②: no

The maintainer's ruling, quoted on the card: 「建议给 dev 模式定一个"噪音预算":预期中的降级记 info,堆栈只在 `--log-level debug` 出现,真正需要动手的那条单独高亮并给一行修法。」 This PR is the printer's half, per the seat's scope cut (claim `6053785493`). The level each other lane's line is logged at stays with its owner. The table below names each owner.

## What changes (`packages/cli/src/utils/format.ts`, `printBootDiagnostics` only)

- **The record that needs the author prints first, once, highlighted, with its one-line fix.** A closed table, `ACTIONABLE_BOOT_CLASSES`, holds one row today: `@objectstack/objectql`'s `[action-governance] declared script actions with NO handler` (a dead button). It is matched the way #22097's `restatedAbove` matches. The highlighted line is the record's statement plus its subjects (the `actions` list from the record's structured tail). The fix is derived from the producer's own message: the text after its `; `, as `leadSentence` derives a flow reason. Nothing is hand-copied. A reworded producer that drops the `;` still prints highlighted and whole. It is never dropped.
- **The header counts the two apart:** `⚠ Boot diagnostics — 1 needs your attention · 2 informational:`. With nothing actionable the header reads `ℹ Boot diagnostics — 4 informational (2 more already listed above):`, with no alarm glyph. The exception is a capture that dropped records: the printer has not read those, so the header keeps the `⚠`.
- **Stack traces are withheld at the default level.** The record's structured tail is located (pretty, text and JSON renderings) and every `stack` property whose value is a V8 trace is dropped. A `stack` key that names something stays. The message stays. A record without a trace prints byte-identical. The last line counts what was withheld and points at `--log-level debug`.
- **The debug half needs no code.** At `--log-level debug` (and `info`), `serve` never opens the boot-quiet window (`isVerboseBootLevel`). The same record streams live as `ObjectLogger` rendered it, stack included, and no replay block prints. Measured both before and after (below). `serve.ts` is untouched.
- #22097's print-once and `restatedAbove` rules are unchanged.

## Measured (`origin/main` `7d7943dd`, built `packages/cli/dist`, `os dev --fresh`)

Blank starter (from `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank`, namespace `support_desk`) plus the tutorial's four files, extracted verbatim from `build-with-claude-code.mdx` as it stood at `7d7943dd`, `--ui`. At that commit Resolve was a script action with an unregistered `target`. #22204 has since made it a declarative update, which needs no handler (see the re-measure after the merge, below):

```text
before:
  ⚠ Boot diagnostics — 3 warnings logged during startup:
    … WARN [Analytics] No admitObjectRead configured … (one line)
    … WARN [action-governance] declared script actions with NO handler — a button wired to nothing (ADR-0078); add a `body`, or register a handler under the declared `target` {"count":1,"actions":["support_desk_ticket:resolve_ticket"]}
    … WARN Insert operation failed {"object":"sys_migration","error":{"message":"UNIQUE constraint failed: sys_migration.id [statement and bound values redacted]","stack":"SqliteError: … (10 knex/driver/engine frames)"}}
after:
  ⚠ Boot diagnostics — 1 needs your attention · 2 informational:
    ⚠ [action-governance] declared script actions with NO handler — a button wired to nothing (ADR-0078): support_desk_ticket:resolve_ticket
      fix: add a `body`, or register a handler under the declared `target`
    … WARN [Analytics] No admitObjectRead configured … (one line)
    … WARN Insert operation failed {"object":"sys_migration","error":{"message":"UNIQUE constraint failed: sys_migration.id [statement and bound values redacted]"}}
    1 stack trace withheld — run with --log-level debug to watch the boot stream live, stacks included
```

`examples/app-showcase` (`dev --seed-admin --fresh`): before, `⚠ Boot diagnostics — 4 warnings logged during startup (2 more already listed above):` with the `sys_migration` stack. After, `ℹ Boot diagnostics — 4 informational (2 more already listed above):` with the stack withheld. The four records are `[Analytics]`, `[SettingsService]`, `sys_migration` and `[sharing-rule]`, none actionable. The banner's two `Flows:` class lines are unchanged.

`--log-level debug` on the blank project, before and after: 0 replay blocks; the `sys_migration` record streams live 1 time, carrying `"stack":"SqliteError…` 1 time.

On `main` the blank project shows 3 records, not the card's 4. The loopback OAuth line moved to `info` in #22097 and is gone at the default level.

**Re-measured after merging `origin/main` (`7b926f76`, which carries #22204), at head `f8a80640`.** The blank starter plus the tutorial's current four files (Resolve is now `operation: 'update'` + `patch`) prints `ℹ Boot diagnostics — 2 informational:`, which is `[Analytics]` and the `sys_migration` insert with its stack withheld, plus the hint line. Nothing there needs the author any more. The two remaining lines are #22154's and #22099's to lower.

## Each non-actionable line and its owner (H5)

| line (default level) | level | emitter | owner | card tracking its level |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `[Analytics] No admitObjectRead configured and no "security" service registered at init …` | warn | `packages/services/service-analytics/src/plugin.ts:1450` | `domain:services` | #22154 (open) |
| `Insert operation failed {"object":"sys_migration", …}` | warn | logged at `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts:14006`. The duplicate insert is plugin-auth's default-org owner bind recording id `adr-0093-default-org-owner-bind` twice (debug stream, blank project) | `domain:services` (plugin-auth) | #22099 (open) |
| `[SettingsService] Pre-bind READ of namespace 'auth' …` | warn | `packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.ts:774` | `domain:services` | none known to this PR |
| `[sharing-rule] active business-unit rule expands to NO recipients …` | warn | `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-rule-service.ts:1524` | plugin-sharing | none known to this PR |
| `N flow(s) declare a 'schedule' / 'time_relative' trigger but are NOT bound — disabled by deployment policy …` | banner class line (yellow `⚠`), restating `service-automation`'s `warn` | `printAutomationSummary` (this file) restating `packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts:1533` | claim routes it to `service-automation`; see the open question in the report | none known to this PR |

The dev did not search the tracker for the three "none known" rows. The role file reserves search for the filing seat. Dedupe words are in the report.

## Pins

`packages/cli/src/utils/format.boot-warning-classes.test.ts` (unit tier; 11 existing + 7 new legs):

- **Real producers, all three log formats** (`it.each` over pretty / text / json): a real `ObjectLogger` writes through the real `BootLogCapture`. The real `runActionGovernanceInventory` runs over a ticket whose Resolve is a script action with an unregistered `target`. The dead button prints once, first, highlighted, ending `: support_desk_ticket:resolve_ticket`. The next line is `fix: ` plus the inventory's own message after its `; `, read off the producer at call time. The header carries `1 needs your attention · 2 informational`.
- **Stack withheld at the default level:** a failed-insert record built from a real thrown `Error` is captured with its escaped stack (premise asserted). It prints with `object` and `error.message` and no `"stack"`. No escaped frame is anywhere on screen. One hint line names the count and `--log-level debug`.
- **Stack at `--log-level debug`:** `isVerboseBootLevel('debug')` holds. A debug-level `ObjectLogger` writes the same record to the terminal with its stack.
- **Formatter:** a `stack` key that is not a trace prints unchanged. A capture with dropped records keeps the `⚠`.
- **#22097's legs stay green.** Three of them asserted the header string verbatim, which is the text this ruling replaces. Those three expectations now read the new header. Their withheld counts are unchanged (`(3 more already listed above)`, `(1 more …)`), and every class and print-once assertion is untouched.

`packages/cli/test/serve-boot-diagnostics-noise-budget.e2e.test.ts` (new; integration tier by behaviour, nightly by name). The blank starter is scaffolded through the real on-ramp `bin/`. Added to it: the tutorial's ticket object, its current declarative Resolve, and one `Escalate` script action whose `target` nothing registers. Real `os serve` then boots. Boot diagnostics highlights exactly Escalate's record, with one `fix:` line. Its header says `1 needs your attention`. Resolve, the control in the same boot, is named on no line, and no stack trace reaches the block. No informational count is pinned, because the owners above are moving those.

### Ablations

Each ran on the committed fix through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP mode). The unit legs ran at `77f6a48c`. The boot-pin leg ran at `77f6a48c` and again at `f8a80640`, red both times; `format.ts` is the same blob at both. Each anchor hit 1 time, the write was verified on disk by blob change, and each restore was proven `blob == HEAD` with an empty `git diff HEAD`. The test subjects import `format.ts` / `boot-log-capture.ts` from source, so no `dist` is involved. Expected direction: red. Observed: red every time.

| leg | mutation | result |
|---|---|---|
| A | class row's record text no longer matches | 3 failed / 18 (the three format legs) |
| B | `stack` traces kept | 1 failed / 18 (the withholding leg) |
| C | fix never split off (`at = -1`) | 3 failed / 18 |
| D | any string `stack` withheld, trace or not | 1 failed / 18 (the narrowness leg) |
| E | dropped records no longer keep the alarm | 1 failed / 18 |
| G | `isVerboseBootLevel` without `debug` | 1 failed / 18 (the debug leg) |
| A, boot pin | class row's record text no longer matches | 1 failed / 3 (the highlight assertion) |

Final restore proof: `format.ts` blob `9dc1b9d9` and `boot-log-capture.ts` blob `d2545d2e` equal `HEAD`'s, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Tests and gates

All readings at head `f8a80640`, after merging `origin/main` `7b926f76`; the merge had no conflicts and the CLI closure was rebuilt, 59/59.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0. `tsc --noEmit` passed, then `check:test-typecheck: OK … 3 file(s) / 28 error(s) / 6 pinned signature(s)`, unchanged. Both test files are in a tsc program (`--listFilesOnly`): the unit pin under `tsconfig.json`, the e2e under `tsconfig.test.json`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 263 passed (263)`, `Tests 3881 passed (3881)`.
- The new e2e was run locally because the diff adds an integration-tier file: `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration --maxWorkers=2 test/serve-boot-diagnostics-noise-budget.e2e.test.ts` gave `Tests 3 passed (3)`. The rest of the integration tier is declared to CI.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 65 for this change set (5 paths vs merge base `7b926f76`). Against the order's list, that adds `check:cli-test-child-env` and drops `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` and `check:route-envelope`, which no path here reaches. I ran the union of 68, full `pnpm lint` included. 67 exit 0. `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main` exits 1: that is the release-note correction named under Changeset. `dispatch-gates --ran`: `65 derived, 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- Full `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`): exit 0.
- At `e1a46a46`, before the merge, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` printed PREREQUISITE NOT MET because eight packages had no `dist`, so it measured nothing. After building them it was green (106 require entries across 66 packages load), and it is green at `f8a80640`.

## Changeset

`.changeset/22160-boot-diagnostics-noise-budget.md`, `@objectstack/cli` `patch`.

**A pending release note is corrected here, and that needs a person's confirmation.** One sentence in `.changeset/22073-boot-warning-one-line-per-class.md` (pending, not yet released) quoted the old header verbatim: `⚠ Boot diagnostics — 5 warnings logged during startup (8 more already listed above):`. This PR changes that header, so the sentence would publish false. It now quotes only the withheld count, `(8 more already listed above)`, which stays true; nothing else in that note moved. `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main` is red on this PR by its own design. It refuses any edit to a changeset the PR did not add, and for a deliberate correction it asks the PR to name the note and get it confirmed. The alternative is to restore the note from base and let the superseded sentence publish.

## Acceptance notes

- **The card is not closed by this PR.** Its pin 4 (the blank template boots with `0 warnings`; the showcase boots with no non-actionable line above `info`) depends on the owners in the table above.
- **Boundary:** at `--log-level info` the quiet window does not open either, so a record's stack streams there too. Changing what `ObjectLogger` renders at `info` is `packages/core`'s, not this printer's.
- **Candidate actionable classes, not added (the table is closed and grows by a row with a real-producer pin):** `[action-governance] registered handlers with NO declaration …` (its fix is hedged, not `;`-shaped), and the runtime-assets `Branding asset not served … To fix, …` (its fix is introduced by `To fix,`, not by `; `). Neither appeared on the measured boots.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`'s showcase boot-health reading classifies the `Flows:` banner's `⚠` lines and needs no change. On a stock showcase the *Boot diagnostics* header is now `ℹ`.
